meta.title: Prayer times
meta.description: Daily adhan and iqamah times at Al Muttaqin Cultural Center, Matsudo, Chiba, with the monthly schedule, sunnah times, Ramadan imsakiyah, and a calendar download.

hero.title: Prayer times in Matsudo, Chiba
hero.description: Adhan and iqamah times at Al Muttaqin, calculated for the mosque's location and reviewed by the committee. All times are Japan Standard Time (JST).

arc.label: Arc of the day from sunrise to sunset with today's prayer times

table.title: Schedule for {month}
table.description: Adhan times for each day of the month. Today's row is highlighted and Fridays are marked.
table.caption: Prayer times for {month}, Asia/Tokyo (JST)
table.offsetRule: {prayer} {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} after adhan
table.imsakNote: Imsak is 10 minutes before Fajr and is shown only during Ramadan.

guide.title: How the times are calculated
guide.hanafi: Hanafi (shadow equals twice the object length)
guide.jumuahBody: Khutbah starts at {time} every Friday. Please see the Jumuah page for this week's khatib.
guide.timezoneBody: Asia/Tokyo (JST, UTC+9). Japan does not observe daylight saving time.
guide.notificationsBody: Open the Jamaah app to receive adhan and iqamah notifications on your phone and to keep the schedule offline.

sunnah.title: Night prayer and other times
sunnah.description: Guidance for voluntary prayers today, calculated from today's Maghrib and tomorrow's Fajr.
sunnah.lastThirdHint: The best time for tahajjud and dua
sunnah.duhaHint: From about 15 minutes after sunrise until shortly before Dhuhr
sunnah.forbidden: Times when voluntary prayer is avoided
sunnah.forbiddenNoon: When the sun is at its highest, a few minutes before Dhuhr

ramadan.title: Today's imsakiyah
ramadan.description: Imsak is 10 minutes before Fajr. Iftar begins at Maghrib. May Allah accept your fast.
ramadan.done: It is time to break the fast. May Allah accept your fast and prayers.
